title: 826. Count Unique Characters of All Substrings of a Given String

examples.explanation: Single letters give 3, pairs give 4, the triple gives 3.
The full string scores only 1 because A repeats.

hints: Think per character occurrence: an occurrence at position i with neighbours prev and next is the unique one exactly for starts in (prev, i] and ends in [i, next).
Keep the last two seen positions for each of the 26 letters and add (i - last1) * (last1 - last2) as you scan.
After the scan, flush each letter once more using the string length as the virtual next occurrence, taking the total modulo 1e9+7.
